subject: issue in endoR with dorsal/ventral fur differences

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: issue in endoR with dorsal/ventral fur differences
parts:
Hi everyone,
I just spotted an issue in endoR which becomes apparent when you have different fur properties dorsally and ventrally. It resulted in the program using the mean of dorsal and ventral rather than explicitly using dorsal for the part of the organism facing up and ventral for the part facing down. It's fixed in the latest push to github.
All the best,
Mike
